objective: Find a free, traceable, independent source explicitly publishing match-level xGA; do not infer xGA by copying the opponent's xG.

reviewed_sources.name: J.League Data Site official match cards
reviewed_sources.match_level_xg: not published on reviewed official match cards
reviewed_sources.match_level_xga: not published on reviewed official match cards
reviewed_sources.decision: not a usable xG/xGA source; retain for score, lineup, bench and substitution verification

reviewed_sources.name: FootyStats J1 League xG page
reviewed_sources.match_level_xg: recent-result table exposes home and away xG pairs for displayed recent matches
reviewed_sources.match_level_xga: aggregate xGA by team and venue shown; no explicit per-match xGA field verified on public page
reviewed_sources.decision: usable only for individually matched displayed xG pairs; not accepted as independent explicit match-level xGA source

reviewed_sources.name: TACTIX J1 League xG table
reviewed_sources.match_level_xg: page states 169 matches with xG on both sides, source apisports_proxy
reviewed_sources.match_level_xga: page exposes team-level xPts table, not a raw match-level xGA field
reviewed_sources.decision: candidate for further traceability work; not accepted as match-level xGA source

reviewed_sources.name: JPick public J.League stats
reviewed_sources.match_level_xg: site states data sourced from SportMonks; public match xG display not yet independently extracted for the 130-row sample
reviewed_sources.match_level_xga: no public downloadable explicit match-level xGA field verified
reviewed_sources.decision: not accepted yet; source lineage points to SportMonks

reviewed_sources.name: Sportmonks xG Data API
reviewed_sources.access: paid xG add-on; official page lists xG Basic at EUR 15/month paid yearly
reviewed_sources.match_level_xga: explicit xGA metric per fixture documented
reviewed_sources.decision: technically qualifies as a field/source candidate, but excluded because user requires free data

conclusion: As of 2026-11-03, no free public source reviewed passed all four requirements for independent, traceable, explicit match-level xGA. Keep all 130 xGA pairs blank. Continue checking free providers for raw fixture-level xGA rather than deriving it from the opposing team's xG.
next_checks: Inspect JPick public match detail pages and source payloads to determine whether a per-fixture xGA field is exposed free of charge.
Check whether TACTIX exposes downloadable match-level xG values with fixture IDs and traceable provider attribution rather than only aggregated xPts.
Only add xGA when both teams' values and fixture identity are directly evidenced by a source; preserve URL and source timestamp.
